author: Ian
title: Grain-free Granola
ingredients: ¼ cup coconut oil or butter, melted
1 cup nuts; chopped, walnuts, pecans, hazelnuts, macadamia nuts
instructions_list: Melt coconut oil or butter in a small saucepan.
Spread onto a large baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes at 275 degrees until golden brown and fragrant. Be sure not to over-bake. Granola will crisp as it cools.
Store at room temperature in an airtight container for up to 1 month.
description: One of the biggest questions I get is “What can I have instead of cereal?” Yes, if you’re following my approach, conventional breakfast cereal is off the table. My recipe for grain-free granola gives you the satisfaction of a crunchy, lightly sweet “cereal” without the refined grains.
